blurb: Guests enjoy captained sailing charters on a boat with a maximum of six passengers. Options include three-hour sails, half day, full day, and multi-day sailing experiences including overnight stays. Sailing routes vary depending on wind and tide, with opportunities to swim, fish, and visit marinas.
extraNote: 50% deposit required to secure reservation · Deposits refundable if captain decides it is not safe to sail · Deposits generally not refundable if rainy or calm, but rescheduling possible · 20% discount for returning customers, active duty military, homeland security, veterans, and first responders; discounts cannot be combined · Park near the boat ramp next to the porta-potties at Island Moorings Marina. After crossing the aluminum gangway, look for the boat with the big green strip near the top of the mast.
